sequencing.owner_reply: Phase A first: SEC-only corporate events (Recommended)
sequencing.effect: Build event_normalization/ + corporate_event_parser/ on SEC EDGAR data alone first -- no new provider, no new terms review, directly extends nre/ingestion.py. FDA/ClinicalTrials.gov (Phase C) and earnings surprise (Phase B) follow later, each its own authorized step.

consensus_data_gap.effect: Earnings surprise normalization (Phase B, not yet started) will be built only against prior guidance/prior period using real SEC/issuer data, explicitly labeled as such -- never against consensus. Revisit consensus only if a legitimate free/ToS-compliant source is later found or named.

not_a_claim: Not Milestone 3 acceptance -- nothing has been built yet.

Not a claim that Phase A alone satisfies M3's own criterion ("raw public announcements reliably become structured machine-readable event features") -- that needs real, tested code plus the owner's own review, the same as every prior phase.
